phases.name: prep
phases.description: DF3.6b Leg A (crossing): marker phase before the resident's first solicitation. The run_start solicitation is where the staged allocator (QDS_PI_BIN) crosses the manifest's 134217728-byte memory.max and the kernel OOM-kills the leaf; both phases exist so the journal can prove the run CONTINUED deterministic after the kill (story AC1). No model call, no retries: requiredBudgetMs = 2*1*3*10000 + 2*5000 = 70000 < 80000 (manifest.ts refuses the manifest when declared ceilings exceed runBudgetMs — same coupling t4.resident.pipeline.json documents).

phases.name: settle
phases.description: DF3.6b Leg A (crossing): marker phase after the resident has been stopped by the OOM arm. The status gate refuses any further solicitation, so this phase runs with the resident already terminal — its success in the journal is the deterministic-completion clause of AC1.
